author: EmuCore - Hub
title: There's a New PS2 Emulator Fork on Android
summary: A rigorous NetherSX2 Turnip versus Classic test across Snapdragon 865, 8 Gen 2 and 8 Elite handhelds, with wins and regressions reported separately.

blocks.text: Retro Game Corps explains that NetherSX2 Turnip embeds several Adreno Turnip drivers and can coexist with another NetherSX2 installation. The comparison uses a Retroid Pocket 5, Retroid Pocket 6, AYN Thor and AYN Odin 3 to cover three Snapdragon generations, then repeats game workloads against NetherSX2 Classic rather than relying on one flagship result.

The conclusion is intentionally mixed: some games improve significantly with the Turnip fork, while others run worse. The driver path is designed for supported Adreno hardware and does not translate to Mali devices. Fork variant, Vulkan driver, chipset and per-game behavior all remain part of the result, making this a useful antidote to “newer is always faster” claims.
